name: C++ Win32 + inbox RichEdit 8 (msftedit.dll) + md4c -> RTF

variants.notes: BEST. Windowless RichEdit (CreateTextServices + own ITextHost2, GDI TxDraw into a memory DC). Text services created + first viewport chunk streamed on a helper thread while the UI thread creates/shows the window; ImmDisableIME; whole doc loaded later on the helper into a 2nd instance and swapped in

classic windowed RICHEDIT50W child control (GDI/Uniscribe), md4c on a worker thread, first viewport chunk streamed before first paint, rest reloaded after; ImmDisableIME, read-only by input filtering (no EM_SETREADONLY)

windowless RichEdit with TXTBIT_D2DDWRITE: ITextServices2::TxDrawD2D (DirectWrite) into a software ID2D1DCRenderTarget; helper thread for text services + 3rd thread warming D2D/DWrite. Hardware HwndRenderTarget is ~180 ms slower (D3D device), see README
windowed control, whole document streamed before the first paint (no first-viewport chunk): shows the cost of the naive approach on large docs
